issues: [code-quality] doc.go:56 names verbatim_test.go as the file enforcing the copy contract, but the enforcement lives in contract_test.go and verbatim_test.go does not exist in the tree. README.md:63 already names contract_test.go, so the two disagree. This is the one comment whose whole job is to stop silent divergence. Fix: '// A comment cannot enforce that, so contract_test.go does. It reads the focal arm's'. The sentence ~12 lines below is correct as written.

[code-quality] TestFullPickerPathIsDeterministicUnderAnAllZeroScoreField (plugin_test.go ~1253-1265) does not exercise the hazard its failure message describes, so the 60 iterations prove less than they appear to. runArm (plugin_test.go:530-540) builds `scored` by ranging the Filter's output slice in order, so the input to Pick is deterministic across all 60 iterations and nothing samples the map shuffle at scheduler_profile.go:199-205. The message at :1262 asserts 'the input slice is map-ordered', which is true in production but not in this harness. What the test does validly prove and should keep: endpoints go in as decode-c, decode-a, decode-d, decode-b and the winner is asserted to be decode-a, showing decide imposes ID order rather than following slice order. Fix: shuffle `scored` per iteration before calling Pick so the loop genuinely samples orderings, or drop the loop to 1 and reword the message to claim only what the fixture shows.
reviews.summary: NEEDS_CHANGES. Two small issues, both in documentation/test-fidelity rather than in the algorithm; everything substantive passed and was verified from primary sources rather than from the writer's summary. Verified independently: the verbatim contract without relying on contract_test.go (coeffs.go, admission.go, rollout.go, shadow.go byte-identical modulo the package clause, each exactly 6 bytes smaller; types.go and shared.go deletion-only with zero added lines), plus the gap a subsequence check leaves open -- all 17 function bodies in shared.go and all 5 structs in types.go byte-identical, no declaration absent from its focal source, scorerFirstSnapshots correctly absent, kernels.go/capacity.go/retiming.go correctly absent. The objective matches the spec statement-for-statement with only the two mandated adapter substitutions; math.Max(remoteLeadUs, tAdmD) unconditional with no flag near it; local omits tIterFirstDecode while disagg adds it; thetaD prices decode and thetaP prefill; decide enumerates plain ascending ID with the 1e-12 strict threshold and takes no scorer arguments; preferredByScore gone with its math import. Config is a strict subset with every retained field matching name, type and JSON tag, and validate() the focal arm's minus tau/V/capacity with no shared check weakened. Registration chain confirmed at the pin: backward-only name resolution requires handler-before-picker, configloader.go:279 is the one-ProfileHandler error, both producer spellings exact. Overlay format correct (no inferenceExtension key), zero invented keys, exactly five focal-only blocks dropped, all 12 coefficients matching inputs/ to the last digit; deep merge run by the reviewer confirms the plugins string replaces the baseline's wholesale while epp.replicas, pluginsConfigFile, inferenceObjectives, the tokenizer sidecar and --enable-force-include-usage propagate. Gates re-run by the reviewer: build, vet, -race across all five profilehandler packages, golangci-lint 0 issues, TestDecideEnumeratesTheFullCrossProduct stable over 30 runs. Focal arm byte-identical to a pre-round SHA-256 snapshot. Judgement calls answered: byte-identity over editorial polish agreed; dropping Policy.table verified correct (every .table read is h.table); omitting Ablation/decomposed correct and adding it would have been a fidelity violation. Process note (resolved during review, not an issue): the generated mirror briefly disagreed with the target repo, holding the older map-ranging version of the cross-product test.
